title: From Zero to ₹1 Lakh Crore Empire | Zoho | Sridhar Vembu’s Inspiring Startup Journey | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "From Zero to ₹1 Lakh Crore Empire | Zoho | Sridhar Vembu’s Inspiring Startup Journey | Live Hindi"

https://www.zoho.com/en-in/workplace/?utm_source=influencer&utm_medium=referral&utm_id=LivehindiYT

In this inspiring video, we take you through the incredible journey of Zoho Corporation and its visionary founder Sridhar Vembu — a man who proved that world-changing technology doesn’t have to come from Silicon Valley.

Learn how Sridhar Vembu left behind a comfortable life in the U.S., returned to rural India, and built Zoho, one of the most successful bootstrapped tech companies in the world — with 100M+ users across 180+ countries.

🔍 What you’ll discover in this video:

How Zoho started in 1996 as AdventNet

Why Sridhar Vembu chose to move to a village in Tamil Nadu

The unique rural development model behind Zoho's operations

How Zoho became a profitable, self-funded tech giant without any external investors

Lessons from Sridhar Vembu's minimalist lifestyle and leadership

Zoho’s current position as a leading provider of cloud-based business software
